parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The image ID. You can call [ListImages](~~449118~~) to obtain the image ID.

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to display non-essential information, which contains tags. Valid values:

*   false (default)
*   true

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace get-image --image-id image-4c6200000053uor --verbose false --region cn-hangzhou
